channel.title: Ayush Kashyap — Notes
channel.description: Engineering notes on building production healthcare software — multi-tenancy, FHIR interop, and data modeling at scale.

item.title: Field Notes #03: Some fixes can skip the App Store
item.description: Store releases versus over-the-air updates, explained as parcels through customs and letters straight to the phone, and why skipping customs means becoming your own.

item.title: Field Notes #02: Never let the AI sign its own work
item.description: The simplest safety pattern for AI that writes anything important: treat it like a new intern. It drafts, a person signs, and nothing is saved until it's signed.

item.title: Field Notes #01: Multi-tenancy is a housing problem
item.description: Three ways to keep every customer's data apart in one system, explained as houses, flats and a hostel, and four rules for living in the cheapest one.

item.title: Two marketplaces, one schema
item.description: Modeling carpooling and peer-to-peer car rental in a single PostgreSQL schema: what to share, where to diverge, and migration discipline.

item.title: Shipping three codebases solo
item.description: Two years building Letsdrive's Flutter app, Express/Prisma backend, and Next.js admin alone — the judgment it takes to ship and maintain three codebases solo.
